_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Mercenary#000.src: Talk to the Scout in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or find one in another town.
The Mercenary#000.dst: 到 {p} 的 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與偵察兵談話，或在其他城鎮找一位。

The Mercenary#002.src: Admiral Amerigo of the Almuji Army requests the aid of able-bodied and unmoored soldiers from around the Province of Wynn.
The Mercenary#002.dst: Almuji 軍的 Amerigo 上將，向 Wynn 行省各地身強體健、尚無隸屬的士兵徵求援助。
The Mercenary#002.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#003.src: To put it bluntly... they've run into a predicament over there. {p}'s standing army has been taken captive, and the desert barracks overtaken.
The Mercenary#003.dst: 說白了……那邊出了麻煩。{p} 的常備軍被俘，沙漠兵營也被佔了。
The Mercenary#003.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#004.src: The Admiral has sent scouts round to gather any free-moving soldiers to help him... remedy the situation.
The Mercenary#004.dst: 上將派了偵察兵四處去召集所有能自由行動的士兵，幫他……收拾這個局面。
The Mercenary#004.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#005.src: ... If you ask me, I reckon he'd like this taken care of quietly and discreetly. I don't blame the man, really, given the circumstances.
The Mercenary#005.dst: ……要我說，他大概是希望這件事悄悄地、低調地解決。以現在的情況，我也不怪他。
The Mercenary#005.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#006.src: Anyhow, if you can, travel on over that way. {p} is the desert city to the east of {p}, if you've never seen it.
The Mercenary#006.dst: 總之，方便的話就往那邊走一趟。{p} 是 {p} 東邊的那座沙漠城市，沒去過的話記一下。
The Mercenary#006.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#007.src: With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
The Mercenary#007.dst: 那我就先走了！還有很多士兵要找。你要是決定應召，祝你好運！
The Mercenary#007.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#013.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#016.dst: Almuji 軍的 Amerigo 上將，向 Wynn 行省各地身強體健、尚無隸屬的士兵徵求援助。
The Mercenary#016.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#017.dst: 說白了……那邊出了麻煩。{p} 的常備軍被俘，沙漠兵營也被佔了。

The Mercenary#018.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#019.dst: ……要我說，他大概是希望這件事悄悄地、低調地解決。以現在的情況，我也不怪他。
The Mercenary#019.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#020.src: Anyhow, if you can, head on over to the Admiral's office. It's just by the bank, you can't miss it.
The Mercenary#020.dst: 總之，方便的話就到上將的辦公室走一趟。就在銀行旁邊，不會找不到。
The Mercenary#020.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#021.src: With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
The Mercenary#021.dst: 那我就先走了！還有很多士兵要找。你要是決定應召，祝你好運！
The Mercenary#021.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#023.src: Ugh, for crying out loud- I'm busy, can't you see that? I don't have time to...
The Mercenary#023.dst: 唉，我的老天——我在忙，你看不出來嗎？我沒空……
The Mercenary#023.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#024.src: Ah. You're a soldier. Good, that's one more to add to the list. You met the scout, I'm sure.
The Mercenary#024.dst: 啊。你是士兵。很好，名單上再添一個。你見過偵察兵了吧，我想。
The Mercenary#024.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#025.src: Not as many of you lot as I would have hoped for, but it'll have to do. Come down here, the others are in the briefing room already.
The Mercenary#025.dst: 你們的人數比我期望的少，不過也只能將就了。下來吧，其他人已經在簡報室了。
The Mercenary#025.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#026.src: Hmph. I suppose this is as many soldiers as we'll be able to get. Very well!
The Mercenary#026.dst: 哼。看來我們能湊到的士兵就這麼多了。也罷！
The Mercenary#026.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#027.src: To begin with - the situation. Commander Takan of {p} has abandoned his post, and has taken the lead of a group of local bandits.
The Mercenary#027.dst: 首先——說明狀況。{p} 的 Takan 指揮官已棄守職位，並帶頭領導了一群當地強盜。
The Mercenary#027.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#028.src: Under his command, they were able to strike our forces in the dead of night, and have taken over the barracks to the northeast.
The Mercenary#028.dst: 在他的指揮下，他們在深夜突襲了我方部隊，並佔領了東北方的兵營。
The Mercenary#028.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#029.src: Our entire military force, captured or killed! What a disgrace. We've sent messengers to {p}, and they have promised their support...
The Mercenary#029.dst: 我方全部的軍力，不是被俘就是被殺！何等恥辱。我們已經派信使前往 {p}，他們也承諾會支援……
The Mercenary#029.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#030.src: But I would like this dealt with quickly and quietly. That's where you five come in.
The Mercenary#030.dst: 但我希望這件事又快又安靜地解決。這就是你們五個要做的。
The Mercenary#030.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#031.src: You will attack and infiltrate the barracks, and assassinate our treasonous commander. I will leave the strategizing to you, as there is much I still must handle here.
The Mercenary#031.dst: 你們要攻進並潛入兵營，暗殺那名叛國的指揮官。戰術由你們自己擬定，我這邊還有許多事要處理。
The Mercenary#031.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#032.src: A question, if I may. Do we know the commander's reasoning for this attack? It seems out of character.
The Mercenary#032.dst: 容我問一個問題。我們知道指揮官發動這場攻擊的理由嗎？這不像他會做的事。
The Mercenary#032.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#033.src: ...No. There is nothing that I can recall that would motivate such an attack. Will that be all?
The Mercenary#033.dst: ……不知道。我想不出有什麼會促成這樣一場攻擊。就這樣了嗎？
The Mercenary#033.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#035.src: Then I must be off! Good luck, soldiers. I hope for a swift end to this disaster.
The Mercenary#035.dst: 那我得走了！祝好運，士兵們。希望這場災難能盡快落幕。
The Mercenary#035.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#036.src: ...Well, darn. Bandits sound like trouble. Do we know what sort?
The Mercenary#036.dst: ……唉唷。強盜聽起來就麻煩。知道是哪一夥的嗎？
The Mercenary#036.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#037.src: Does it matter? We'll probably be fighting them no matter what kind they are.
The Mercenary#037.dst: 有差嗎？不管哪一夥，我們八成都得跟他們打。
The Mercenary#037.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#038.src: It might, actually... Some bandit groups are stronger than others. If we know which group we're dealing with ahead of time, it might-
The Mercenary#038.dst: 其實有差……有些強盜團比別的強得多。要是能事先知道對手是哪一夥，或許就能——
The Mercenary#038.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#039.src: We've been standing around here for too long. Come on, let's make our way closer to the barracks. We can come up with a plan there.
The Mercenary#039.dst: 我們在這裡站太久了。走吧，先靠近兵營再說。計畫可以到那邊再想。
The Mercenary#039.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#044.src: Well, darn. The place is swarming with bandits...
The Mercenary#044.dst: 唉唷。那地方滿滿都是強盜……
The Mercenary#044.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#045.src: I don't see how that's a problem! We can just launch explosives into the crowd, and boom, problem solved.
The Mercenary#045.dst: 這哪算問題！我們往人堆裡丟炸藥，轟一聲，問題解決。
The Mercenary#045.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#047.src: We can't do that. You'd almost certainly damage the structure in the process!
The Mercenary#047.dst: 不能那樣做。你幾乎肯定會在過程中破壞到建築本身！
The Mercenary#047.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#048.src: Ah, true. Can't forget about the historical value. Good catch.
The Mercenary#048.dst: 啊，也對。不能忘了它的歷史價值。你提醒得好。
The Mercenary#048.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#049.src: ...Right. Well, anyway, I don't think we can get through those bandits with brute force. We'll have to try to find a way around them...
The Mercenary#049.dst: ……是啊。總之，我不覺得我們能硬闖過那些強盜。得想辦法繞過去……
The Mercenary#049.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#050.src: Well, if I may interject- I reckon I won't be of much use in proper combat! Injured leg, 'n all. Makes moving a little hard!
The Mercenary#050.dst: 那個，容我插句話——我看我在正經打鬥裡是幫不上什麼忙啦！腿有傷嘛。動起來有點吃力！
The Mercenary#050.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#051.src: So, if we think goin' right in won't work, I could try to create a distraction? I've got the magic for it, and I'd be of much more use out here.
The Mercenary#051.dst: 所以呢，既然覺得正面進去行不通，我來製造個聲東擊西怎麼樣？我有這方面的魔法，待在外頭反而派得上用場多了。
The Mercenary#051.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#052.src: It could work... if I join you, we'd be able to draw attention towards us while the others sneak in from a different angle.
The Mercenary#052.dst: 這可能行得通……如果我跟你一起，我們能把注意力引到自己身上，讓其他人從另一個方向潛進去。
The Mercenary#052.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#053.src: Good idea. But, how do we get in? I don't think there is another entrance, other than that one in front.
The Mercenary#053.dst: 好主意。但我們要怎麼進去？除了前面那個，我不覺得還有別的入口。
The Mercenary#053.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#055.src: This had better not be going where I think it is, Linton.
The Mercenary#055.dst: Linton，這句話最好不是往我想的那個方向去。
The Mercenary#055.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#056.src: Okay, maybe it is. But, listen! We don't have any entrances, right? What if we made our own... by blowing a hole through a wall?
The Mercenary#056.dst: 好啦，可能就是。可是你聽我說！我們沒有入口對吧？那我們自己做一個……在牆上炸個洞，怎麼樣？
The Mercenary#056.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#057.src: ...Alright, fine. That sounds like it could work.
The Mercenary#057.dst: ……好吧，就這樣。聽起來確實可行。
The Mercenary#057.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#059.src: Exactly! You need to have more faith in the experts, Aledar.
The Mercenary#059.dst: 沒錯！Aledar，你該多信任專業人士一點。
The Mercenary#059.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#060.src: We all need to make sacrifices, Lanu.
The Mercenary#060.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#061.src: Hm. No, I don't think I do. Either way, that sounds like a plan. {u}, Linton, and I will break into the barracks then.
The Mercenary#061.dst: 嗯。不，我不覺得我該信。總之，這算是個計畫了。那就由 {u}、Linton 和我闖進兵營。
The Mercenary#061.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#063.src: And Lanu and I can distract 'em while you do so. Sounds like a plan! Let's get goin'.
The Mercenary#063.dst: Lanu 跟我就在你們動手的時候引開他們。這計畫可以！走吧。
The Mercenary#063.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#065.src: Well, well. This looks like a good place to break our way in, wouldn't you say, Aledar?
The Mercenary#065.dst: 哎呀哎呀。這裡看起來很適合炸出一條路進去，你說是不是啊，Aledar？
The Mercenary#065.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#066.src: Yes, Linton, it looks fine. {u}, we'll be looking for Takan. I think the two of us could take him out.
The Mercenary#066.dst: 是啊 Linton，看起來不錯。{u}，我們去找 Takan。我想我們兩個應該解決得了他。
The Mercenary#066.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#067.src: And I'll be looking for the captured soldiers! I stole a map of the barracks from Amerigo's desk, so I'll be able to find them easily enough!
The Mercenary#067.dst: 我去找那些被俘的士兵！我從 Amerigo 桌上偷了一張兵營地圖，要找到他們輕輕鬆鬆！
The Mercenary#067.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#068.src: You-... nevermind, I don't care. Just do your job, please?
The Mercenary#068.dst: 你——……算了，我不管了。把你的事做好就是了，拜託？
The Mercenary#068.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#070.src: See you two on the other side!
The Mercenary#070.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#073.src: Damn it... damn it, damn it, damn it ALL! Couldn't give me a MOMENT of peace, could he, that rat Amerigo...
The Mercenary#073.dst: 可惡……可惡、可惡、全都給我去死！連「一刻」的安寧都不肯給我，是吧，那隻叫 Amerigo 的老鼠……
The Mercenary#073.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#074.src: ...do I really need to do everything myself?! It's almost as though-
The Mercenary#074.dst: ……什麼事都非得我自己來不可嗎？！這簡直就像——
The Mercenary#074.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#075.src: Oh, I see. I see what's going on. More of Amerigo's dogs, here to take care of his business, huh?! Get out here where I can see you.
The Mercenary#075.dst: 噢，我懂了。我懂是怎麼回事了。又是 Amerigo 的狗，跑來替他辦事，是吧？！出來，站到我看得見的地方。
The Mercenary#075.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#076.src: You look new... haven't been around long enough to really see the face of War up close and personal yet, have you?
The Mercenary#076.dst: 你看起來是新來的……還沒待得夠久，還沒真正近距離看過「戰爭」的臉，對吧？
The Mercenary#076.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#077.src: You think this is right? You think it's right that those DAMNED admirals get all the wealth and fame, when WE'RE the ones out fighting in the trenches?!
The Mercenary#077.dst: 你覺得這樣是對的嗎？那些「該死的」上將把財富和名聲全部拿走，而在戰壕裡拚命的是「我們」——你覺得這樣是對的嗎？！
The Mercenary#077.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#078.src: I've seen soldiers fall and fall and fall, then rise back up again. I've lived through the chaos and death of battle more times than I could count.
The Mercenary#078.dst: 我看過士兵倒下、倒下、再倒下，然後又爬起來。我在戰場的混亂與死亡裡活下來的次數，多到我自己都數不清。
The Mercenary#078.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#079.src: And these IDIOTS think they deserve their power? Their authority?!
The Mercenary#079.dst: 而那些「蠢貨」竟然覺得自己配得上那份權力？那份權威？！
The Mercenary#079.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#080.src: ...You've killed dozens, and you're keeping dozens more captured.
The Mercenary#080.dst: ……你殺了幾十個人，還關著幾十個人。
The Mercenary#080.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#081.src: And I'd do all that and more, just to prove my point! They think they hold power?! I'll show them power...
The Mercenary#081.dst: 為了證明我說的是對的，這些我還會做得更多！他們以為權力在他們手上？！我讓他們看看什麼叫權力……
The Mercenary#081.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#082.src: I suppose I'll start with you. What are two more compared to dozens?
The Mercenary#082.dst: 那就從你們開始吧。都幾十個了，再多兩個算什麼？
The Mercenary#082.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#083.src: Step aside, Shadow Spears. I'd like to deal with these dogs myself.
The Mercenary#083.dst: 讓開，Shadow Spears。這兩隻狗我想自己來。
The Mercenary#083.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#084.src: ...We won't make it easy for you.
The Mercenary#084.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#089.src: This tower can only go up... Come on, we need to chase after him! We can't let him get away!
The Mercenary#089.dst: 這座塔只能往上……走，我們得追上去！不能讓他跑掉！
The Mercenary#089.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#090.src: Continue up the stairs in the barracks.
The Mercenary#090.dst: 沿著兵營的樓梯繼續往上。

The Mercenary#093.src: Look, it's obvious we've lost here. Even if that idiot escapes, you military folk will find him.
The Mercenary#093.dst: 聽著，我們這邊明擺著是輸了。就算那個蠢蛋跑掉，你們這些當兵的也會把他找出來。
The Mercenary#093.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#094.src: So, I surrender! Don't see the point in fightin' a pointless battle. Not like we're gonna be paid after this mess, anyhow.
The Mercenary#094.dst: 所以呢，我投降！打一場沒意義的仗有什麼意思。反正搞成這樣，我們也拿不到錢了。
The Mercenary#094.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#095.src: Here, take the key to the tower. A sign of good faith. Do what you will with him, I really don't care.
The Mercenary#095.dst: 喏，塔的鑰匙拿去。表個誠意。你們要拿他怎麼樣都隨便，我真的不在乎。
The Mercenary#095.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#096.src: I always preferred his brother anyway. Much quieter.
The Mercenary#096.dst: 反正我一直比較喜歡他哥哥。安靜多了。
The Mercenary#096.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#097.src: Ugh, more bandits... I'll hold them off here.
The Mercenary#097.dst: 唉，又是強盜……我在這裡擋住他們。
The Mercenary#097.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#098.src: Keep going after Takan! I'll be fine!
The Mercenary#098.dst: 你繼續去追 Takan！我沒事的！
The Mercenary#098.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#099.src: Head up the tower and take out Takan.

The Mercenary#100.src: Urgh... Why did I even come up here?! There's nowhere for me to-
The Mercenary#100.dst: 唔……我幹嘛跑上來？！這裡根本沒地方讓我——
The Mercenary#100.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#101.src: ...Oh. L-listen. We can talk this out-
The Mercenary#101.dst: ……噢。聽、聽我說。這件事我們可以談——
The Mercenary#101.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#104.src: ...and so then, I had to free them somehow! So I shouted at them to brace for it, and-
The Mercenary#104.dst: ……然後呢，我總得想辦法把他們放出來吧！所以我就對他們大喊叫他們站穩，接著——
The Mercenary#104.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#105.src: {u}! There you are! I'm glad you made it out safely. It looks like the bandits are dispersing.
The Mercenary#105.dst: {u}！你在這裡！你平安出來真是太好了。看樣子強盜們正在散去。
The Mercenary#105.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#106.src: And so is my train of thought for my story. So! Did you get him?
The Mercenary#106.dst: 我故事的思路也跟著散了。所以！你們解決他了嗎？
The Mercenary#106.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#107.src: That's good to hear. At least something good came of this whole situation...
The Mercenary#107.dst: 聽到這個真好。至少這整件事還是有點好結果……
The Mercenary#107.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#108.src: I'm glad we managed to take him out after all. The things he was saying... he seemed like a dangerous man.
The Mercenary#108.dst: 我很慶幸我們終究把他解決了。他說的那些話……他看起來是個危險的人。
The Mercenary#108.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#109.src: Oh, not this again. You're still on that?
The Mercenary#109.dst: 噢，又來了。你還在想那個？
The Mercenary#109.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#110.src: I caught a few of the things he was shoutin' from outside. It didn't sound very pleasant.
The Mercenary#110.dst: 我在外頭聽到幾句他吼的話。聽起來可不太舒服。
The Mercenary#110.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#111.src: Some of us care about history, Mel.
The Mercenary#111.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#112.src: Well, I didn't hear a thing. Probably on account of the ringing in my ears. It seems to me we're done here, though, right?
The Mercenary#112.dst: 我可是什麼都沒聽到。大概是因為耳朵還在嗡嗡響。不過依我看，我們這邊算是完事了吧？
The Mercenary#112.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#113.src: It looks like it, yes. I think I'll stay behind to help the soldiers clear out the remaining bandits.
The Mercenary#113.dst: 看來是的。我想我會留下來，幫士兵們清掉剩下的強盜。
The Mercenary#113.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#114.src: I figure I'll stick around too. Don't got anythin' better to do right now, anyway!
The Mercenary#114.dst: 那我也留下來好了。反正現在也沒別的事好做！
The Mercenary#114.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#115.src: Well, I'm out of here. I've got places to be! Things to do! Explosives to return! Goodbye!
The Mercenary#115.dst: 好啦，我閃了。我有地方要去！有事情要辦！有炸藥要還！再見！
The Mercenary#115.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#116.src: {u}, I guess that leaves the two of us to return to {p} with the news! Let's get going.
The Mercenary#116.dst: {u}，那看來就剩我們兩個回 {p} 報信了！走吧。
The Mercenary#116.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#117.src: Bring Takan's badge to Amerigo at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Mercenary#117.dst: 把 Takan 的徽章帶到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 交給 Amerigo。

The Mercenary#118.src: Soldiers! Report! Don't tell me you're the only two survivors, damn it all...
The Mercenary#118.dst: 士兵們！報告！別告訴我活下來的只有你們兩個，該死……
The Mercenary#118.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#119.src: No, sir, the mission was a success. Takan is dead.
The Mercenary#119.dst: 不，長官，任務成功了。Takan 已經死了。
The Mercenary#119.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#120.src: You're certain of this? You have his badge, surely...?
The Mercenary#120.dst: 你確定？他的徽章總帶回來了吧……？
The Mercenary#120.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#121.src: I see... satisfactory work, soldiers. You two, and the others, have {p}'s gratitude.
The Mercenary#121.dst: 我明白了……做得還算令人滿意，士兵們。你們兩位，還有其他人，都會得到 {p} 的感謝。
The Mercenary#121.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#122.src: Admiral, sir. Some of what Takan is saying, it was-
The Mercenary#122.dst: 上將，長官。Takan 說的那些話裡，有一些是——
The Mercenary#122.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#123.src: I wouldn't put too much stock in those traitor's words. People like him, who spit vitriol with no merit, riling up the masses against the order we hold.
The Mercenary#123.dst: 我勸你別太把那個叛徒的話當一回事。像他那種人，滿口毫無根據的惡毒言語，煽動群眾去反抗我們維持的秩序。
The Mercenary#123.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#124.src: He is an angry man holding a grudge for an imagined wrongdoing. There is nothing more to it than that. I would suggest putting it out of your mind.
The Mercenary#124.dst: 他不過是個心懷怨恨的憤怒之人，而那份委屈是他自己想像出來的。事情就是這麼簡單。我建議你別再放在心上。
The Mercenary#124.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#125.src: You will all be well-compensated for your work today. Now, run along. I have to collect my honorary badge for taking out Ex-Commander Takan.
The Mercenary#125.dst: 你們今天的付出都會得到優厚的報酬。好了，去忙你們的吧。我得去領我那枚「剷除前指揮官 Takan」的榮譽徽章了。
The Mercenary#125.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#127.src: I'm starting to see why Takan hated him so much.
The Mercenary#127.dst: 我開始有點明白 Takan 為什麼那麼恨他了。
The Mercenary#127.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#128.src: I'll... probably try to speak to Admiral Aegis about that the next time I'm in {p}.
The Mercenary#128.dst: 我……下次到 {p} 的時候，大概會試著跟 Aegis 上將談談這件事。
The Mercenary#128.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#129.src: Anyway! What an adventure, right? I can't wait to tell Tasim about it.
The Mercenary#129.dst: 總之！真是一場冒險，對吧？我等不及要跟 Tasim 說了。
The Mercenary#129.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#130.src: ...Speaking of. Have you heard from him recently? I can't seem to get ahold of him at all.
The Mercenary#130.dst: ……說到這個。你最近有他的消息嗎？我怎麼樣都聯絡不上他。
The Mercenary#130.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#131.src: It's weird. Last I heard, he was at {p}, but he's not there anymore.
The Mercenary#131.dst: 很奇怪。我最後聽到的消息是他在 {p}，但他已經不在那裡了。
The Mercenary#131.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#132.src: He- what? Really? And he didn't even tell me...
The Mercenary#132.dst: 他——什麼？真的假的？他竟然連跟我說都沒說……
The Mercenary#132.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#133.src: ...I guess it must have slipped his mind. That's alright. We're all busy around here, right?
The Mercenary#133.dst: ……大概是一時忘了吧。沒關係。大家都很忙嘛，對吧？
The Mercenary#133.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#134.src: A general location is useful, though. I'll see if I can get any letters to him. Thanks for telling me.
The Mercenary#134.dst: 不過知道個大概位置也很有用。我看看能不能寄封信給他。謝謝你告訴我。
The Mercenary#134.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#135.src: Yeah, that makes two of us...
The Mercenary#135.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#136.src: Well, it's probably fine. I'm sure he'll pop up eventually! We just need to wait.
The Mercenary#136.dst: 唉，應該沒事的。我相信他總會冒出來的！我們等著就是了。
The Mercenary#136.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#137.src: I wonder where he's gone off to? Some kind of assignment in {p}, maybe? Or could he have gone off to Gavel...?
The Mercenary#137.dst: 他到底跑去哪了呢？也許是在 {p} 出了什麼任務？還是說他跑去 Gavel 了……？
The Mercenary#137.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#138.src: Well, whatever. It was good to see you again! Even if... well. Even if it was strange.
The Mercenary#138.dst: 唉，算了。能再見到你真好！就算……嗯。就算過程有點古怪。
The Mercenary#138.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#140.src: Well, I guess I'm going to head off. I'll see you around, {u}!
The Mercenary#140.speaker: Aledar
